definitions.explanation: A house provided at public expense to a high-ranking official — a prime minister, governor, mayor, or ambassador — for the duration of the post. The occupant lives there but does not own it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公邸|こうてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The governor lives in the official residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{公邸|こうてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A press conference was held at the prime minister's official residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧{公邸|こうてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれ→招く：02425_maneku⟧、⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{来賓|らいひん}→来賓：28580_raihin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to a dinner at the ambassador's official residence and had a chance to talk with guests from various countries.

notes:
Formed from {公|こう} (public) + ⟦{邸|てい}→邸：23029_tei⟧ (mansion, residence). Usually appears attached to the title of the post: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{公邸|こうてい}, ⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧{公邸|こうてい}, ⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧{公邸|こうてい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公邸|こうてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to move into the official residence
- {公邸|こうてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to leave the official residence
- {公邸|こうてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hold talks at the official residence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{私邸|してい}→私邸：30145_shitei⟧: private residence — the official's own home, contrasted directly with {公邸|こうてい}
- ⟦{官邸|かんてい}→官邸：12305_kantei⟧: official residence and office — for the prime minister, ⟦{官邸|かんてい}→官邸：12305_kantei⟧ is the working headquarters, {公邸|こうてい} the living quarters
- {官舎|かんしゃ}: government housing — ordinary housing for civil servants, not a mark of high rank
